name: New Caledonia
prevalence_note: OPT-NC, the local post and telecom operator, has alerted the public to fraudulent parcel messages, reported by the public broadcaster's local service.
cross_border_note: New Caledonia (+687) uses six-digit local numbers distinct from mainland France, so scam texts referencing métropole carriers are a hint of fraud.

scams.name: Fausse alerte OPT sur un colis
scams.name_en: Fake OPT-NC parcel message asking for a fee or data

red_flag_keywords.text: payer les frais de dédouanement en ligne

scams.signals_en: A message styled as OPT-NC says a parcel has landed and asks for a customs fee or personal data via a link.
scams.legit_en: OPT-NC's assistance pages are the official route for parcel questions; it has warned against these fraud attempts.
bait_tactics: Demander à quelle agence OPT de Nouméa le colis est arrivé
Dire qu'on passera à l'agence avec l'avis de passage
